heroSub: Ten Krabi honeymoon stays we've reviewed in depth — from Phulay Bay, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve with a butler in every villa, and Rayavadee on the boat-only Railay–Phra Nang peninsula, to Banyan Tree with a private pool in every room, quiet boutique resorts along Tubkaek and Klong Muang beaches, and a rooftop infinity pool in the heart of Ao Nang on a lighter budget. From approx. ฿2,000–22,000/night.
introH2: 🏝️ Why Krabi suits a honeymoon, and how to pick the right stay for you two
introHtml: Krabi is one of the Andaman coast's favourite honeymoon destinations — limestone cliffs rising straight out of the sea, white-sand beaches, islands you can reach by longtail in a single day, and resorts that genuinely deliver privacy, from beachfront pool villas to hideaways you can only get to by boat · But “honeymoon hotel in Krabi” comes in very different flavours, and picking the wrong zone changes the whole mood of the trip · The first group is the quiet luxury beach resorts along Klong Muang and Tubkaek — Phulay Bay, Banyan Tree, The Tubkaak, Dusit Thani, Nakamanda and Sofitel — which sell calm, pool villas, spas and sunset views, in exchange for being far from restaurants, with several shallow tidal beaches where you mostly swim in the pool · The second is boat-only Railay–Phra Nang — Rayavadee and Sand Sea — where you get white-sand, clear-water beaches and a car-free feel, in exchange for the hassle of coming and going by boat · The third is central Ao Nang, like Aonang Cliff, where you can walk everywhere on a lighter budget, plus Koh Lanta, like Avani+, which is slower and quieter · How to choose for the two of you: want a private pool in your room? Look at the pool-villa group (Banyan Tree has one in every room). Want to walk straight into clear water? Choose Railay–Phra Nang. Rate service and privacy above all? That's Phulay Bay. On a budget? Go for Ao Nang or Sand Sea on Railay · This guide gathers 10 Krabi honeymoon stays we've reviewed in depth — every one drawn from reading real guest reviews, with the honest upsides and trade-offs, a 3-site price compare and direct booking links.
mrtHtml: Krabi has no train system. You get around mainly by hotel transfer, taxi/Grab, rental car, and longtail boat for the boat-only stays · The honeymoon hotels here are spread across several zones, and matching the zone to the trip you picture matters more than you'd think · Railay–Phra Nang peninsula (boat access only) — Rayavadee and Sand Sea sit here, with white-sand beaches, limestone cliffs and a car-free feel, in exchange for having to boat in and out every time · Tubkaek–Klong Muang beaches (north of Ao Nang, ~15–25 min) — Phulay Bay, Banyan Tree, The Tubkaak, Dusit Thani, Nakamanda and Sofitel cluster here, quiet and private for pure relaxation, but many beaches are shallow and tidal and there are no shops around, so you drive out to Ao Nang · Central Ao Nang — Aonang Cliff Beach Resort is walking distance to the beach, restaurants, the walking street and the pier, the most convenient base for evenings out · Koh Lanta — Avani+ Koh Lanta is on a slower, quieter island that needs an extra ferry/drive from Krabi town · Good to know: many of the luxury stays along Klong Muang–Tubkaek and on the headlands have steep paths, stairs or buggy transfers, so if anyone is elderly or has limited mobility, ask for a room near the centre when you book.

rooms.type: Beach Villa (closest to the sand + private pool)

entries.storyHtml: If this honeymoon is meant to be the trip you remember for life, Phulay Bay, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve is the name real reviews rank number one in Krabi — one of only a handful of Reserves in the world, with 54 villas and pavilions on a private bay at Nong Thale, a dedicated butler for each one who handles everything from unpacking to arranging boat trips, and a private pool in a walled garden for more than half of them. Its 9.7 is the highest score in this set · Guests praise service that remembers your name and preferences, food with barely a miss, and a quiet oceanfront infinity pool · Honest trade-offs: the beach out front is shallow and the tide goes far out, so it's not for swimming — you use the pool or take a boat to Hong Island — the location is remote with no shops nearby, and prices are among the highest in Krabi · Best for couples marking a special occasion who value privacy and service above everything else.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The heart of the resort is the Pool Villa with its private pool and walled garden — if the budget stretches, skip the pavilion. Book in low season, when prices drop noticeably and the value equation changes. Have your butler set up a beachfront dinner or a private boat trip to Hong Island in advance, and mention your special occasion when booking so the team can surprise you.
pros: 9.7, the highest score in the set · Reserve-level service with a butler in every villa
Spacious, very clean villas with beautiful Thai woodwork and fabrics; over half have a private pool
Quiet and very private, with a lovely oceanfront infinity pool — ideal for a honeymoon
Food across every outlet earns praise; the big spa and private dining impress
cons: Among the highest prices in Krabi · food and drinks in the resort are steep
The beach out front is shallow and tidal, not for swimming — use the pool or boat to an island
Remote, with no shops nearby; getting to Ao Nang or town means a drive (from reviews)

entries.type: Luxury 5-star · The Leading Hotels of the World
entries.name: Rayavadee
entries.revCount: Score 9.4 · 599 reviews · The Leading Hotels of the World · boat access only
entries.badge: ⛰️ Railay–Phra Nang · reachable by boat only
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Phra Nang–Railay peninsula · ~15 min boat from Ao Nang
tags: 🍸 The Grotto, a bar inside a limestone cave
entries.addr: 214 Moo 2, Tambon Ao Nang, Amphoe Mueang Krabi
entries.storyHtml: Rayavadee hides on the Phra Nang peninsula, which has no road in — a 15-minute boat from Ao Nang drops you into a world of nothing but sea, white sand and limestone cliffs. A member of The Leading Hotels of the World, it scores 9.4 · Its 94 two-storey rotunda pavilions are tucked into the jungle across three beaches, and some come with a hydro pool or private pool. Real reviews agree it suits honeymoons and celebrations especially well, above all The Grotto, a bar set inside a limestone cave on Phra Nang beach where you sip a cocktail at sunset · Honest trade-offs: you boat everywhere, which is inconvenient if you want to hop between spots each day; food, drinks and tours inside the resort cost several times more than outside; and mosquitoes are heavy in the rainy season · Best for couples who want to disappear into limestone-and-sea nature with five-star service layered on top.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a private pool, go for a Hydro Pool Pavilion or above and book early, as they're limited. Reserve a sunset dinner at The Grotto the moment you check in. Walk over to Phra Nang beach and cave early, before the crowds, and bring your own mosquito repellent if you're travelling in the rainy season.
pros: On the Phra Nang peninsula, reachable by boat only — extremely private and rare
Wrapped around 3 white-sand, clear-water beaches · The Grotto cave bar is a highlight
Spacious pavilions set among limestone jungle; staff remember guests' names, five-star service
Many reviews call it the best fit for a honeymoon or milestone celebration
cons: You boat everywhere you go — inconvenient if you like visiting several places
Food, drink and tours inside the resort cost several times more than outside
Heavy mosquitoes in the rainy season · public beach gets busy midday (from reviews)

entries.addr: Tubkaek Beach, Moo 3, Nong Thale, Mueang Krabi
entries.storyHtml: Banyan Tree Krabi sits on Tubkaek Beach, which faces west straight toward the limestone islands. The detail that fits a honeymoon best: every room is a suite or villa with its own private pool and terrace — there are no standard rooms at all, 72 in total, scoring 9.3 · Real reviews praise the privacy, the island views at sunset that photograph well from every angle, the Banyan Tree Spa and its Rainforest circuit, and the Thai restaurant Saffron, reached by a little tram for the sunset · Honest trade-offs: Tubkaek is 20–25 minutes from Ao Nang and the shuttle runs only a few times a day; the in-suite pools are plunge pools, not for real swimming; and the beach is tidal, so the sea retreats far at low tide · Best for honeymooners and spa lovers who want a quiet, private beach with a pool in every room.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a full sea view, choose a Premium Ocean Pool Suite on a higher floor. Check the tide table so you can plan a sea swim at high tide. Make the most of the free activities — yoga, kayaks, sailing — and reserve a sunset table at Saffron in advance.
pros: Every room has a private pool and terrace, no standard rooms — ideal for a honeymoon
Island and sunset views from Tubkaek Beach are lovely and photograph well
Banyan Tree Spa + Rainforest earn high praise · staff remember guests' names
Free yoga, kayaks and sailing · Saffron Thai restaurant has a great setting
cons: Far from Ao Nang and town restaurants; you rely on a car or a shuttle that runs a few times a day
In-suite pools are small plunge pools, not for serious swimming
Tubkaek is a tidal beach — swimming is awkward at low tide (from reviews)

entries.storyHtml: Dusit Thani Krabi Beach Resort (formerly the Sheraton Krabi) is a 240-room, 5-star resort on Klong Muang Beach, calmer and quieter than the Ao Nang strip. It scores 9.2 from 1,774 reviews — the largest review base in this set, a sign of a beachfront resort proven by a lot of guests · Real reviews praise warm staff who remember guests (9.6), broad tropical gardens with two beachfront pools, and spacious, clean, comfortable rooms — a good fit for couples who want a calm seaside base at a price easier to reach than the pool-villa group, with a Club Suite and plunge pool for those who want to upgrade · Honest trade-offs: Klong Muang is shallow, with sea grass and a tide that retreats far, so most people swim in the pool; it's away from the buzz, so you drive to Ao Nang; and in-resort extras are pricey · Best for couples who want a quiet sea, beachfront pools and full facilities at a sensible price.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a sea view, choose the Deluxe Premium Sea Facing. For a private pool, step up to the Club One Bedroom Suite with Plunge Pool, which also adds Club Lounge access. Book in low season for a clearly better price, and budget for a Grab when you head out to eat or for a night in Ao Nang.
pros: Klong Muang Beach is quiet and private, with pretty sea and island views
Warm, attentive staff who remember guests (staff score 9.6) · largest review base in the set
Broad gardens and two beachfront pools · spacious, clean, comfortable rooms (9.5)
More reachable price than the pool-villa group · Club Suite with plunge pool to upgrade

Away from the buzz, a ~15–20 min drive to Ao Nang
In-resort extras are pricey (value score 8.9, the lowest across categories)

entries.storyHtml: The Tubkaak Krabi Boutique Resort is a mid-size, 59-room, 5-star boutique at the far end of the Klong Muang coast that sells quiet and a private beach with barely a stranger on it, plus full Andaman island and Hong Island views. It scores 9.1 · Real reviews praise the easy, personal service where staff remember your name, the seaside Italian restaurant Di Mare with its romantic setting and sunset views, and the pool villas and Ocean View rooms many say are worth the upgrade · Honest trade-offs: it's 20–25 minutes from Ao Nang and you rely on a car throughout; nights are quiet with nothing to do outside the resort; the Garden Room is a garden view, not a sea view; and there are mosquitoes some evenings · Best for couples who want to escape the crowds for a quiet, slow-living beach stay.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If a sea view matters, skip the Garden Room for an Ocean View Pool Villa. Book a sunset dinner at Di Mare ahead. Have the resort arrange a morning boat trip to Hong Island or Koh Poda, and pack mosquito repellent for the evenings.

Di Mare, seaside Italian with a romantic setting at sunset

entries.addr: 39 Moo 2, Railay West Beach, Ao Nang, Mueang Krabi
entries.storyHtml: Want to wake up to Railay's white sand and limestone cliffs without paying luxury-resort rates? Sand Sea Resort is one of the few 4-star beach resorts actually on Railay West Beach, reachable by longtail only, with a car-free atmosphere. It scores 9.1 from 411 reviews · Real reviews praise the beachfront location where you step from your room onto the sand, the ~5-minute walk across the peninsula to the east beach so you catch both sunrise and sunset, and staff who quickly arrange boats and climbing/kayak tours · Honest trade-offs: some rooms are dated and inconsistent; boat access is tough in the monsoon when seas are rough; the main restaurant doesn't serve alcohol; and island prices run higher than the mainland · Best for couples who value sleeping on Railay Beach and the natural setting over how new the room is.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If the budget allows, choose a Tropical Villa or Villa Plus, which are in better shape than the entry rooms. Book with free cancellation in case you want to change rooms. Check the forecast if you're coming in the rainy season and have the hotel arrange your boat ahead. And walk over to Phra Nang beach and cave, close by, early in the morning.
pros: Genuinely on Railay West Beach, straight from room to sand, with a great sunset spot
Walk across to both beaches · car-free, quiet and leafy
On Railay at a mid-range ~฿2,600 — the best value in the set for this location
Friendly staff who quickly arrange boats and climbing/kayak tours
cons: Some rooms look dated, with worn fittings and inconsistent condition
Boat access only, tough when seas are rough · island prices higher than the mainland
Main restaurant doesn't serve alcohol · limited fresh fruit at breakfast (from reviews)

entries.addr: 126 Moo 3, Klong Muang, Nong Thale, Mueang Krabi
entries.storyHtml: Nakamanda Resort & Spa is a small, 5-star boutique of 39 villas on Klong Muang Beach, built around teak and stone and set in tropical gardens beside the Andaman Sea. It scores 9.0 · The honeymoon fit: many villas have a private plunge pool or jacuzzi, backed by strong privacy and easy, personal service where staff remember your name. Real reviews also praise the Naga Spa and the live-cooking breakfast — a good match for couples escaping the Ao Nang crowds for a slow-living stay · Honest trade-offs: it's about 20 minutes from Ao Nang and nights are very quiet; there are plenty of stairs and slopes along the hillside; the Sala Villa is a garden view, not a sea view; and prices run fairly high versus nearby resorts of the same level · Best for couples who love villa design and quiet, private beachfront.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a sea view, choose the Sala Villa Sea View or Jacuzzi Villa Seaview. If stairs are hard for you, ask for a ground-level villa near the pool/restaurant when booking. Make the most of the free kayaks and yoga, and plan an evening out to eat in Ao Nang, as in-resort dinner options aren't very varied.
pros: Contemporary Thai teak villas with a very private feel
Many have a private plunge pool/jacuzzi · quiet Klong Muang Beach with limestone views
Warm staff who remember guests · Naga Spa and the live-cooking breakfast earn praise
Free kayaks and yoga, a lovely pool setting — great for a slow-living stay
cons: Far from Ao Nang and town restaurants; you always need a car, and nights are very quiet
Plenty of stairs and slopes along the hillside · the Sala Villa is a garden view
Fairly pricey versus nearby resorts · dinner options aren't very varied (from reviews)

entries.revCount: Score 8.8 · 384 reviews · Avani / Minor Hotels · two private beaches

entries.mrtTag: 📍 Laem Lo Kwang, Koh Lanta · ~10 min from Saladan Pier
tags: 🏖️ Two private beaches on a headland
entries.storyHtml: If you want an island honeymoon that's slower and quieter than the Ao Nang side, Avani+ Koh Lanta Krabi Resort by Minor Hotels sits on Laem Lo Kwang at the northern tip of Koh Lanta. It scores 8.8 from 384 reviews · Reviews praise the headland's two private beaches — one white sand for swimming, the other rocky for exploring at low tide — spacious rooms from 50 sqm, and the clifftop Reggae Bar, the resort's best sunset spot, backed by a 9.2 staff score · Honest trade-offs: the terrain is steep and you rely on buggies often; some mattresses are inconsistent; it's at the island's end, far from the restaurant strip, so you call a ride; and reaching Koh Lanta needs an extra ferry/drive from town · Best for couples who want a quiet, private island beach at a price easier to reach than the mainland luxury resorts.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a sea view or pool access from your room, choose a Sea View or Pool Access Room. Try the mattress the moment you check in and ask to switch if it's not right. Check the buggy transfer if the hills are hard for you, and plan your journey to Koh Lanta with extra time for the ferry/drive from Krabi town.
pros: Two private beaches on the headland, quiet and private, with sea views all around
Spacious rooms from 50 sqm, clean and well laid out · Reggae Bar for sunset
Attentive staff who remember guests and help fast (score 9.2)
More reachable price than the mainland luxury resorts · easy airport transfer
cons: Steep terrain; you rely on buggies often
Some mattresses are firm/sagging, quality is inconsistent
At the island's end, far from the restaurant strip; you call a ride to eat out (from reviews)

rooms.type: Pool Suite (private pool · only 7 of them)

entries.storyHtml: Sofitel Krabi Phokeethra Golf & Spa Resort is a 276-room, 5-star, Indo-colonial resort on Klong Muang Beach, whose signature is a large free-form lagoon pool winding through palm gardens. It scores 8.6 from 531 reviews · For couples who want grand-resort romance, there's the well-reviewed So SPA with L'Occitane, a Club Millésime lounge for suites, and a Pool Suite with a private pool — only 7 of them in the resort — for a special occasion. Real reviews also praise warm staff who greet you by name and a varied breakfast · Honest trade-offs: Klong Muang is shallow, the tide retreats far and there are jellyfish some seasons, so most people swim in the pool; some rooms feel dated; it's away from the buzz, so you drive to Ao Nang; and in-resort food and drink are very pricey · Best for couples who like a grand resort with a spa and a big pool in a garden setting by the sea.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For maximum privacy, choose a Pool Suite — there are only 7. Pick a rate that includes breakfast or half board, since in-resort dining runs several times pricier than outside. Book in low season for a clearly better rate, and budget roughly ฿500–800 for a taxi out to Ao Nang.
pros: Large free-form lagoon pool amid palm gardens, in a quiet beachfront setting
Well-reviewed So SPA with L'Occitane · Club Millésime lounge for suites
Warm staff who remember guests · varied breakfast
Pool Suite with a private pool, only 7 of them, ideal for a special occasion
cons: Klong Muang is shallow, the tide retreats far, jellyfish some seasons; you mostly swim in the pool
Some rooms feel dated · in-resort food and drink are very pricey
Away from the buzz, a ~15–20 min drive to Ao Nang (from reviews)

tags: 🌅 Rooftop infinity pool with Andaman views
🚶 Central Ao Nang, walk to beach/dining/pier

entries.storyHtml: Rounding out the list is a lighter-budget pick for couples who want a great view and an easy, walkable base in central Ao Nang: Aonang Cliff Beach Resort, a cliffside resort whose draw is a rooftop infinity pool with Andaman and limestone-mountain views — the highlight every review points to, especially at sunset. It scores 8.5, from around ฿2,000/night · Real reviews praise the central location within a few minutes' walk of the beach, walking street, restaurants and pier, and renovated, clean, modern rooms with a balcony — a good fit for couples who want a nice setting without paying luxury rates · Honest trade-offs: it isn't right on the beach — that's a ~5-minute walk down — road-facing rooms are noisy with thin walls, and the resort's layout climbs the cliff, so reaching rooms/pool means lifts and several walkways · Best for couples focused on location, the pool view and a budget they can control, as long as they pick the right room.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a higher-floor room on the sea-view or mountain-view side and note "no room facing the road/lift" when booking to avoid noise. Head up for the rooftop infinity pool view at sunset. It's an easy few-minute walk to Ao Nang beach and the walking street, and use the central base to make the most of island boat trips.
pros: Rooftop infinity pool with lovely Andaman views, a highlight hard to find elsewhere in the area
Central Ao Nang, within walking distance of the beach, walking street, restaurants and pier
Renovated, clean, modern rooms with a balcony
From around ฿2,000/night, good value for the view and location you get
cons: Not right on the beach — a ~5-minute walk down
Road-facing rooms are noisy with thin walls, so you must pick the right side
Layout climbs the cliff, with lifts and several walkways to reach rooms/pool (from reviews)

adviceTitle: How to pick the right Krabi honeymoon hotel for the two of you

advice.head: Marking a special occasion, budget's there, want the very best of Krabi
advice.bodyHtml: → Phulay Bay, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve ฿22,000, a butler in every villa, 9.7, the highest score in the set · or Rayavadee ฿16,000 on Railay–Phra Nang, a member of The Leading Hotels of the World

advice.head: Want a private pool in your room
advice.bodyHtml: → Banyan Tree Krabi ฿13,000, a private pool in all 72 suites/villas, no standard rooms · or Nakamanda ฿6,000, teak villas, many with a private plunge pool/jacuzzi

advice.head: Want to walk straight into clear water
advice.bodyHtml: → Rayavadee and Sand Sea ฿2,600 sit on the white-sand, clear-water beaches of Railay–Phra Nang (boat access only) · the Klong Muang–Tubkaek beaches are shallow and tidal, so you mostly swim in the pool

advice.head: Want a quiet, private beachfront boutique
advice.bodyHtml: → The Tubkaak ฿7,500, quiet Tubkaek Beach with seaside Italian Di Mare at sunset · or Nakamanda ฿6,000, 39 teak villas on Klong Muang Beach

advice.head: On a budget but still want a nice setting
advice.bodyHtml: → Aonang Cliff Beach Resort ฿2,000, a rooftop infinity pool with Andaman views, central and walkable in Ao Nang · or Sand Sea ฿2,600, genuinely on Railay Beach

advice.head: Want a quiet sea on a less-crowded island
advice.bodyHtml: → Avani+ Koh Lanta ฿4,200, two private beaches on Koh Lanta with a clifftop Reggae Bar for sunset · or Dusit Thani ฿4,900, calm Klong Muang Beach, the largest review base in the set

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices are approximate starting rates for standard rooms outside peak season and can change by date and season — always check the live price and compare 3 sites before booking · Scores and highlights here come from reading real guest reviews on booking platforms; we did not stay ourselves · Krabi's high season (November–April) pushes prices up clearly, and limited-inventory luxury resorts and pool villas like Phulay Bay, Rayavadee and Banyan Tree tend to fill first, so plan 1–2 months ahead · Many Klong Muang–Tubkaek and headland stays sit on shallow tidal beaches, so check the tide table and expect to use the resort pool as your main swim · Railay–Phra Nang is boat access only, so check the weather during the monsoon (May–October) before you travel · Written by ThailandAddict.com
faqTitle: FAQ — common traveller questions about honeymoon hotels in Krabi

faq.q: ❓ Which is the best honeymoon hotel in Krabi?
faq.a: It depends on your style and budget · If you go by score and service, Phulay Bay, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve at 9.7, with a butler in every villa, is number one in this set · For boat-only Railay–Phra Nang, choose Rayavadee 9.4 · For a private pool in every room, Banyan Tree Krabi 9.3 · For a quiet beachfront boutique, The Tubkaak 9.1 · On a budget, Aonang Cliff 8.5 or Sand Sea 9.1 on Railay

faq.q: ❓ How much does a honeymoon hotel in Krabi cost?
faq.a: In this guide, prices start at approximately ฿2,000–22,000 per night · The lighter-budget end is Aonang Cliff ฿2,000, Sand Sea ฿2,600, Avani+ Koh Lanta ฿4,200, Sofitel ฿4,800 and Dusit Thani ฿4,900 · Mid-to-upper is Nakamanda ฿6,000, The Tubkaak ฿7,500, Banyan Tree ฿13,000 and Rayavadee ฿16,000 · The most luxurious is Phulay Bay from ฿22,000 · All are approximate starting rates outside peak; high season (November–April) rises clearly

faq.q: ❓ Which Krabi honeymoon hotels have a private pool villa in the room?
faq.a: For a private pool in every room, Banyan Tree Krabi is all suites/villas with a pool (72 rooms, no standard rooms) · Phulay Bay has Pool Villas with a private pool and walled garden · The Tubkaak and Nakamanda offer pool villas/plunge pools · Rayavadee has Hydro Pool Pavilions and Villas with a private pool · Sofitel has only 7 Pool Suites

faq.q: ❓ Which zone should we stay in for a Krabi honeymoon — Railay, Ao Nang or Klong Muang?
faq.a: Railay–Phra Nang (Rayavadee, Sand Sea) has white-sand, clear-water beaches and a car-free feel, but you come and go by boat · Klong Muang–Tubkaek (Phulay Bay, Banyan Tree, The Tubkaak, Dusit Thani, Nakamanda, Sofitel) is quiet and private for relaxing, but many beaches are shallow and tidal and far from restaurants · Central Ao Nang (Aonang Cliff) is walkable and easy on a budget · Koh Lanta (Avani+) is slower and quieter but needs an extra ferry/drive

faq.q: ❓ Can you swim at every beach in Krabi?
faq.a: Not always · The Klong Muang and Tubkaek beaches (Dusit Thani, Sofitel, Banyan Tree, The Tubkaak, Nakamanda) are often shallow, with sea grass and a tide that retreats far, so most people swim in the resort pool, and the beach in front of Phulay Bay is also too shallow for swimming, needing the pool or a boat to an island · For walking straight into clear water, Railay West and Phra Nang (Sand Sea, Rayavadee) have whiter sand and clearer water · Check the tide table in advance

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should we book, and how do we get around?
faq.a: In Krabi's high season (November–April), book 1–2 months ahead, especially limited-inventory pool villas and luxury resorts like Phulay Bay, Rayavadee and Banyan Tree, which fill first · In low season, 2–3 weeks ahead is enough and prices drop a lot · Krabi has no train — get around by hotel transfer, taxi/Grab, rental car, and longtail boat for Railay–Phra Nang · Every platform has free cancellation, so lock in a rate early if your plans aren't fixed, then compare Agoda / Booking / Trip.com for the best price

quickAnswerHtml: 10 honeymoon hotels in Krabi we've reviewed — Phulay Bay, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve with a private butler (9.7) · Rayavadee on boat-only Railay–Phra Nang (9.4) · Banyan Tree Krabi with a private pool in every room (9.3) · Dusit Thani on Klong Muang Beach (9.2) · The Tubkaak, a quiet beachfront boutique (9.1) · Sand Sea, on Railay Beach at a reachable price (9.1) · Nakamanda, teak villas with plunge pools (9.0) · Avani+ Koh Lanta with two private beaches (8.8) · Sofitel Phokeethra, lagoon pool + spa (8.6) · Aonang Cliff, a rooftop infinity pool in central Ao Nang (8.5) · Honest takes from real reviews, from approx. ฿2,000–22,000/night, 3-site price compare.
